notes.title: SSCS Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Yesterday the SSCS project, now renamed Space Station Cargo Simulator went into full release on Steam. The game has undergone a number of changes compared to the original version! The game now features a campaign, much improved graphics and additional activities! Check out our updated [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515600/Space_Station_Cargo_Simulator/]Steam page[/url]!

[previewyoutube=EMDlsn6ul8k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Mech update is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are releasing an update to Mech!
This update makes a number of changes to the Analyzer and Vibro Stand. 

Specifically:
[b]Analyzer[/b]
[olist]
[*]Now each company has its own list of shipments, these descriptions are unique and echo the essence of this or that company.
[*]There is no longer a type of cargo delivery - "Enhanced Comfort". In our opinion, this type is not needed as a standalone, so it is now partially merged into "Protected" shipping.
[*]There are much more texts with the cargo description.
[/olist]

[b]Vibro Booth[/b]
[olist]
[*]Vibro Booth now has modes of operation. There are three of them: A, B, C.
[*]Previously you had to put the load on the stand, press the button and find out the result. The process of studying fragility of the load became more complicated, now each company has a list of visual parameters on the basis of which you should choose a vibro-bench mode for each specific load.
[/olist]

Additional:
[list]
[*]GUI bug fixes
[*]Return of Chinese language.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch of 9 August
notes.notes:
Good afternoon,
A small patch.
[list]
[*] Smoother mouse control has been improved
[*] Raised objects no longer collide with the player
[*] More button collisions, making it easier to hit them
[/list]
Thanks for reading!

notes.title: WindStrike Update
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, dear users! I'm ready to present an update that brings a new and final game location - WindStrike. But don't think that this is the end of the game development. This is only part of the journey!
You can see the location trailer here:
[previewyoutube=X5cHBZ93b_4;full][/previewyoutube]

This time you will be sent to help sorting supplies at the old station, which is located deep in the atmosphere of a gas giant, where strong winds and ball lightning rule! Each module of the station is protected by an autonomous life support system, so you'll have to activate a force barrier yourself to protect the module from ball lightning. However, you should remember that activating the force barrier shuts down all electricity in the module - including all sorting mechanisms!

[h1]GAME[/h1]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] New WindStrike location.
[*] New Freight Company - Vulcano
[*] New trucking company - WindStrike
[*] New trucking company - MagneticForce
[*] New menu item - Location description, where location and its peculiarities are briefly described.
[/list]

[b]Changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] Changed system of selecting objects, now it is MUCH more convenient
[*] Changed movement system, now it is more physically correct
[*] Changed English localization part
[*] Small bug fixes
[/list]


[b]Removed:[/b]

[list]

[*] Temporarily removed the Chinese language. Will come back in the next patch.

[/list]

[h1][url=RexxNorilsk.ru]Localization service[/url][/h1]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Button to copy source text
[*] Switch to the next tag after the successful translation of the current one.
[*] Filled in English tags in the service
[/list]

[i]This list of changes does not include all changes.[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.3 IcePick Transfer
notes.notes:
[i] Hello dear users,
Today we present you Update 0.3 IcePick Transfer [/i]
[previewyoutube=LNwfC5udims;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Description: [/b]
This time, SSCS is experimenting with sending you to the snow-covered planet of Lepson, where IcePick Transfer operates, one of the few corporations in the cargo delivery cluster that operates in ultra-low temperatures. And where there is cargo, sorting is needed there, that's the reason for your stay in such unpleasant conditions.

[b] Changes: [/b]
This update adds the following items to the game:
[list]
[*] New location IcePick Transfer
[*] Edited graphs in the Analyzer
[*] Added new charts
[*] Added Discord server button in the main menu
[*] Fixed some bugs
[/list]

We wish you good luck with the new update, and we are already preparing the next one!

notes.title: Update 0.2 Crystal Mine
notes.notes:
[i] Hello dear users,
Today we are showing you the 0.2 Crystal Mine update. [/i]
[previewyoutube=CId4KMfHjBs;full][/previewyoutube]
[b] Description: [/b]
You can now dive to the bottom of the Erkiya sand mines. Will you be able to correctly check all cargoes per shift on time? Will you get into acid? Are you confident in your abilities? Then SSCS sends you to Corvix, where CrystalMine is a mining company, which you can now learn a lot about from public company information.

[b] Changes: [/b]
This update adds the following items to the game:
[list]
[*] New location Crystal Mine
[*] 2 new freight companies
[*] Adjusted company description
[*] Improved responsiveness of controls
[*] Now the shift starts with a request for the first batch of goods
[*] Many bugs fixed
[/list]

[b] And also: [/b]
In addition, we have implemented [url=http://RexxNorilsk.ru/]site[/url] to localize the game into other languages. The site can only be accessed by users with the purchased game on Steam. We look forward to your help in localizing the game into your language.
Site address - [url=http://RexxNorilsk.ru/] http://RexxNorilsk.ru/ [/url]

In addition, we have created a special [url=https://discord.gg/T5RbbpZTFj]Discord - server[/url], where you can ask questions and communicate with developers!
